Vendor profile

AVEVA

AVEVA Group Limited (Schneider Electric) — Global Standard for Process Plant, Marine Hull & Offshore Oil/Gas 3D Engineering (PDMS / E3D)

By GstarCAD Academy Engineering Editorial Board (Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.) Reviewed by Zhang Mingyuan, B.Eng. (Distinguished DWG Graphics Kernel & GRX SDK Architect) Last reviewed 2026-10-26 Editorial Process & Testbed

1. Cambridge CADCentre Origins (1967) to Schneider Electric Industrial Takeover

Founded in 1967 in Cambridge, UK by the British Ministry of Technology as the Computer-Aided Design Centre (CADCentre), AVEVA Group created PDMS (Plant Design Management System) in the 1970s to design clash-free offshore North Sea oil rigs and chemical refineries. Renamed AVEVA in 2001, it acquired Swedish shipbuilding leader Tribon (2004) and real-time operational data historian OSIsoft PI ($5B in 2021), before being fully acquired by French energy giant Schneider Electric in 2023.

2. Dabacon Object Database, Multi-User Spec-Driven Piping & RVM Models

  • Dabacon Multi-User Database (AVEVA E3D Design): Rather than storing geometry in flat files, AVEVA E3D runs on the proprietary hierarchical Dabacon database, allowing 500+ piping, HVAC, cable-tray, and structural designers to work concurrently on a multi-billion-dollar LNG plant with live specification-driven catalog enforcement (PARAGON / SPECON).
  • ISODRAFT & Piping Component Files (PCF): Automatically extracts 2D piping fabrication isometrics with weld numbers, cut pipe lengths, and bill of materials directly from the 3D pipe routing hierarchy.

3. P&ID Drafting & Isometric Post-Processing in GstarCAD 2027

In global EPC petrochemical workflows, process engineers author intelligent P&IDs and post-process thousands of AVEVA E3D exported isometric DWG sheets using GstarCAD 2027. GstarCAD's AutoLISP/GRX batch automation and DWGCOMPARE revision cloud tools verify spool fabrication changes at 15% of the cost of legacy CAD subscriptions.

5. Enterprise Co-Existence, Migration & TCO Optimization Protocol

In production supply chains where upstream 3D models or BIM containers originate from AVEVA Group Limited / Schneider Electric (Cambridge, UK) platforms, engineering IT directors optimize total cost of ownership (TCO) by deploying a tiered seat architecture centered on GstarCAD 2027 and DWG FastView:

  • Verified Data Exchange Pipeline: Automate post-processing of AVEVA E3D/PDMS Isodraft piping isometric DWG outputs and author intelligent P&ID process schematics in GstarCAD 2027 using AutoLISP/GRX batch validation.
  • Eliminating Redundant Seat Rentals: Rather than purchasing high-cost authoring subscriptions for project managers, site engineers, estimators, CNC operators, and quality inspectors who primarily review geometry or annotate 2D DWG/DXF sheets, organizations equip 70%–80% of their workforce with GstarCAD Perpetual Floating Licenses (GstarLM) and FastView 3D.
  • Automated Database Hygiene Before Transmittal: Prior to archiving project deliverables or importing external vendor DWG exports into corporate PDM/CDE vaults, run GstarCAD's batch script sequence (-PURGE RegApps → OVERKILL → AUDIT Yes → INDEXCTL = 3) to guarantee sub-second opening times and zero proxy object corruption.
